label: sim-hci-gulfs-struggling-2
assignment: Gulfs of Execution and Evaluation in a Real App
source: simulated demo student (persona: struggling) run through the real platform
content: I using EasyPaisa app for pay bill. 1. I want to pay electricity bill. 2. I choosing pay bill option. 3. I selecting electric company. 4. I typing bill reference number. 5. I pressing pay button now. 6. I waiting for system process payment. 7. I checking screen for success message. The gulf of execution is typing long reference number because app not have scan feature. The gulf of evaluation is waiting because I not know if payment done or fail. For execution change, add camera scan for bill. For evaluation change, show big tick mark when money go.

viva.summary: The student understands the purpose of the EasyPaisa payment flow and can identify execution and evaluation gaps. They can predict how UI changes affect evaluation and propose concrete improvements, though their prediction of the progress bar could be more precise.

rubric.revise_next: Next, consider how to combine progress indicators with explicit success/failure messages for a complete evaluation solution.

questions.answer: I mean the app is confusing because it does not tell me if the bill is paid right away. It is a gulf of evaluation because I have to guess if the app worked or if I need to try again.
questions.feedback: You clearly explained why not knowing the result is a gulf of evaluation.
questions.prompt: You wrote, "The gulf of evaluation is waiting because I not know if payment done or fail." What did you mean by this statement, and why does it represent a gulf of evaluation in the EasyPaisa app?

questions.answer: If they show a progress bar, I think it would help me see when the payment is finished, but maybe I still won't know if it actually succeeded or failed.
questions.feedback: You recognized that a progress bar helps but noted it may still leave uncertainty about success.
questions.prompt: If EasyPaisa added a progress bar that shows the payment processing status, how would that change address the gulf of evaluation you mentioned?

questions.answer: I’d add a red cross icon next to the tick and a flashing "Error" banner so the user knows it didn’t go through.
questions.feedback: You gave a concrete visual cue (red cross and error banner) for a failed payment.
questions.prompt: You suggested a big tick mark for the evaluation gulf. If the payment failed, what specific visual feedback would you add to ensure the user doesn't mistake it for a success?

messages.body: Mujhe example dena hai lekin samajh nahi aa raha konsa dun. Hint?

Apko har Norman stage ke liye ek specific user action aur uska screen feedback likhna hoga; execution gulf ke liye aapko batana hai ke number type karna kyun mushkil hai, aur evaluation gulf ke liye aapko dikhana hai ke user ko kaise pata chale ke paise bhej diye gaye hain; phir har gulf ke liye ek realistic design tweak suggest karen. Kya aap in points ko thoda detail se apne shabdon mein bata sakte hain?
messages.hint: Socho, jab aap EasyPaisa pe bill pay karte ho, har stage mein user ko kya sochna padta hai aur kya dikhai deta hai?
